title: Traditional handy towels
text: Traditional handy towels. These are large towels with more of a linen feel than a traditional tufted towel.  They work very well for washing windows and general cleanup.  They are as absorbent as "traditional" cloth towels but don't dry as well as paper towels.  Although I prefer a tufted towel because of the absorbency, one advantage of these is that they do dry very quickly.
